text.tspan: The seven tenets of NIST SP 800-207 in ZTC

#TenetZTC implementation1All data sources and computing services are resourcesevery route behind the PEP is a model.Resource with type, zone, layer, sensitivity2All communication is secured regardless of network locationmTLS with SPIFFE SVIDs between all services and devices; IPsec

between sites3Access is granted per sessionevery request is authorized; decisions carry a TTL; re-verify obligations4Access is determined by dynamic policyABAC with context.trustScore, time, zone and emergency mode5Monitor integrity and security posture of all assetsposture signals, ICS IDS,

Prometheus, alert rules6Authentication and authorization are dynamic and strictly enforcedtrust decays over time; strong IDS signal ⇒ compromise ⇒ revocation epoch ⇒ caches flushed7Collect as much information as possible to improve posturehash-chained audit log, metrics, analytics pipeline
